{{Quote|It pains me to say this, Alema. But you are no longer fit to carry a lightsaber."<br />"That means nothing! We'll just build another.|Luke Skywalker confronting Alema Rar about her third lightsaber|<ref name="DN2" />}}
'''Alema Rar's third lightsaber''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|single-bladed lightsaber]] constructed by ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] after her second lightsaber was confiscated by [[Grand Master/Legends|Jedi Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Kr]].

==History==
[[Alema Rar]]'s third [[lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was constructed at some point in [[36 ABY]]<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> after her previous lightsaber was taken from her a year prior by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Kr]] at the beginning of the [[Swarm War]].<ref name="DN1">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> With her lightsaber constructed, Alema brandished the new weapon against Luke Skywalker on the planet [[Woteba]], yet much like her [[Alema Rar's second lightsaber|second lightsaber]], Luke disarmed Alema of her blade. When Alema demanded he return it, Luke did so, but only after using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to destroy the [[Color/Legends|silver]] [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] powering the weapon, making it effectively useless. Taking the still-intact hilt of the lightsaber, Alema was able to resurrect her weapon using a dark blue Adegan crystal; she used this now blue-bladed weapon to duel Luke's sister, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], aboard the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']], and continued to use the weapon throughout the Swarm War.<ref name="DN2" />

Alema Rar was still using this particular lightsaber by [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] when she was approached by the would-be [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Lumiya]] to join her [[Lumiya's Sith|new order]]. Working alongside Lumiya, Alema used her lightsaber to slay the [[Chev]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Tresina Lobi]], on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Alema's last major usage of this lightsaber was at the [[Roqoo Depot]] where she and Lumiya fought in tandem against Luke Skywalker and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]. In a twist of fate which mirrored that of her second lightsaber, Alema was ultimately defeated by Mara Jade and her third lightsaber was confiscated by the Jedi.<ref name="Tempest" />
